{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''drug''' was invented by [[Jenna Zan Arbor]] that could target and erase specific memories. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] wanted to take this drug, so as to erase memories of his late wife [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. Before he could use it, [[Linna Naltree]], a hostage [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] of Jenna's, forcibly injected it into Arbor, and erased most of her memories.
